title: Finni’s Big Day!

quick_start.title: PICK A TASK
lines: Shoot the lit scoop.
Flippers choose your task;
Launch or Action confirms.

quick_start.title: FOLLOW THE LIGHTS
lines: Make the shots on the display.
Finish tasks to unlock more
party preparations.

quick_start.title: FRIENDSHIP MULTIBALL
lines: Complete the right target bank.
Then lock 3 balls on the right
ramp to start multiball.

quick_start.title: CAKE TIME MULTIBALL
lines: Clear the drop targets; hit Finni.
Follow the jackpot shots
to decorate the cake.

quick_footer: DISCO: spin the left spinner when no task is running.

sections.title: START A PARTY TASK
lines: Shoot the scoop when lit. Use the flippers to
choose; confirm with Launch, Start or Action.
Follow the display and flashing shots. Complete
the left target bank to light another task.

sections.title: FRIENDSHIP MULTIBALL
lines: Complete the right target bank to light Lock.
Lock 3 balls on the right ramp to gather friends.
Collect all 6 lit jackpots, then shoot the right
ramp for the super jackpot. Repeat for more!

sections.title: CAKE TIME MULTIBALL
lines: Clear the drop targets to reach Finni. Hit Finni
to start multiball: 2 hits first, more on later tries.
Frost at Finni, collect 5 lit-shot jackpots, then
spin the spinners before time runs out.

sections.title: DISCO LOOPS & MULTIBALL
lines: Spin the left spinner while no task is running.
50 spins start timed Disco Loops; 100 start
Disco Multiball. During Disco Multiball,
shoot either ramp for super jackpots.

sections.title: PARTY SUPPLIES
lines: Collect Kitchen Timer for extra task time;
Party Lights for double task points;
The Checklist for double task progress;
Party Favors for extra points on supported hits.

sections.title: ACTION & BONUS
lines: Complete all 4 lower lanes to earn a power.
Use Action when lit: advance an active task
or collect points. Complete the 4 top lanes
to increase your end-of-ball bonus multiplier.

sections.title: MORE WAYS TO SCORE
lines: Bumpers light Confetti shots: hit them to build
the Friendship jackpot. The right orbit collects
Snacks toward Supply Run Multiball. Follow
lit Supplies and Ribbons for more features.

sections.title: GET READY FOR PARTY TIME
lines: Begin with 3 task choices. Win 3 tasks to open
all 6 preparations, including Hang the Piñata.
Win all 6 to unlock Party Time: a timed
multiball with a changing flashing shot.
